table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
		 CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
		 remarks     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
		 machinename=saleledger.machinename,
		 machineuser=(select users.username from users where users.usercode=saleledger.salesmancode),
		 itemname = item.name,
		 looseqty = Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty), 
		 bonusqty = Sum(dbo.saledetail.bonusqty),
		 yourlotno=saledetail.yourlotno,
		yourexpiry=saledetail.yourexpiry,
		 manufacturer = dbo.manufacturer.name ,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name
		 
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.manufacturer,
		 dbo.accounts

WHERE  dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode >= :ai_sinvcode and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode <= :ai_linvcode  and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode and
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = :al_custcode

Group By dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
			dbo.saleledger.date,
			dbo.accounts.name,
			dbo.saleledger.salesmancode,
			dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			dbo.saledetail.batch,
			dbo.saledetail.expiry,
			saledetail.yourlotno,
			saledetail.yourexpiry,
			dbo.saleledger.machinename,
			dbo.item.name,
			dbo.manufacturer.name
Order By 
	saleinvcode, Min(rowid)
